column1: # Source archives that accompany every release which ships the matching object
# Remote archives are downloaded by scripts/stage-corresponding-source.ps1 and
# accepted only at the SHA-256 recorded here. Repository paths are copied from
# the reviewed vendored artifact. The release workflow uploads every row and
# Digest provenance per row: libreoffice from the .sha256 sidecar on
# download.documentfoundation.org; poppler and poppler-data from the
# LibreOffice 26.2.6.3 download.lst; voikko-fi from the Debian archive's
# signed Sources index; the MSYS2 source packages verified against their
# detached .sig. The dictionaries archive is GitHub's generated tarball of the
# pinned commit; GitHub does not guarantee those bytes stay identical, so a
# hash refusal there means regenerate and re-pin, never skip.
